scope: Bounded independent local-source verification of Phase H6-H8; does not assert Phase H spatial closure or network acceptance.

native_store_balance.state_unit: MWh of the Store bus energy carrier; for MEM hydro this is MWh_water
native_store_balance.power_unit: MW of the Store bus energy carrier; for MEM hydro this is MW_water
native_store_balance.positive_store_p: Discharge/net supply at the water bus; negative Store p charges the Store.
native_store_balance.standing_loss: Loss per hour; retention (1-standing_loss)^w_stores is applied once to the previous energy state.
native_store_balance.energy_bounds: e_min_pu*e_nom <= e_t <= e_max_pu*e_nom, through define_operational_constraints_for_non_extendables at constraints.py:44.
native_store_balance.power_bounds: Store p is an unrestricted continuous operating variable; water-bus connectivity and energy bounds determine possible charging/discharging. Separate turbine/pump Links carry the physical power limits.

cyclic_boundary.e_cyclic_true: At the first active snapshot, previous_e is the final active snapshot output. e_initial is ignored; the shared pre-first-hour/final level is selected within energy bounds.
cyclic_boundary.reported_first_and_last_states: Do not require stores_t.e.iloc[0] == stores_t.e.iloc[-1]. The first output is the state after the first snapshot; the initial pre-snapshot state is the final output under cyclic operation.
cyclic_boundary.global_vs_period: For this single-year chronology use global e_cyclic. e_cyclic_per_period is a separate multi-investment-period rule, not a seven-zone or hydro-class flag.
cyclic_boundary.neutral_interpretation: The cycle cannot supply free annual net stored water. With standing losses, weighted natural inflow plus pumped water equals turbine water plus spill plus standing loss over the cycle.
cyclic_boundary.authority_limitation: This API inspection does not establish new initial/terminal water-level evidence and does not authorize a state-attribute change.

Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.water_bus_balance: p_store + inflow_generator_p + eta_pump*pump_link_p0 - turbine_link_p0 - spill_generator_p = 0 for normal Store sign=+1 and spill Generator sign=-1.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.water_state_equation: e_t = retention_t*e_previous_t + w_stores_t*(inflow_MW_water + eta_pump*pump_p0_MW_electric - turbine_p0_MW_water - spill_p_MW_water).
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.inflow: Forced exogenous Generator: p_min_pu = p_max_pu = inflow_MW_water/p_nom. No turbine efficiency belongs on this water-bus injection.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.turbine: Link bus0=water, bus1=electric. p0 is nonnegative MW_water consumption; p1=-eta_turbine*p0; electrical generation=-p1. p_nom is MW_water and NET electrical capacity is eta_turbine*p_nom.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.pump: Link bus0=electric, bus1=water. p0 is nonnegative MW_electric consumption; p1=-eta_pump*p0; water-state injection=-p1=eta_pump*p0.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.spill: Generator at water bus with sign=-1 and p>=0. Stored generators_t.p is a nonnegative MW_water sink magnitude; actual water-bus injection is -p.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.mixed_PHS: Natural inflow, pump delivery, turbine consumption and spill meet at one water bus with one Store for the same physical reservoir. Native Store/Link APIs do not require a second state.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.pure_PHS: No natural-inflow Generator; electrical pump and turbine act on its Store.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.annual_conservation: Sum_t w_stores_t*(inflow_t + eta_pump*pump_p0_t - turbine_p0_t - spill_p_t) = Sum_t (1-retention_t)*e_previous_t under cyclic operation.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.annual_electrical_generation: Sum_t w_generators_t*(-turbine_p1_t). Use stores weights for water-state balance and generator weights for electrical-energy reports; confirm their equality before comparing totals.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.H8_notation_clarification: The master's power-flow terms require w_stores when expressed in MW. Its unweighted written terms are dimensional only if interpreted as MWh for that snapshot; one-hour snapshots make them numerically equal.
Store_Link_Generator_dimensional_contrac.losses_once: Apply pump efficiency on pump transfer, turbine efficiency on output transfer, and standing retention on Store energy. Do not apply turbine efficiency a second time to inflow or Store balance.

water_value_dual.attribute_definition: .venv/Lib/site-packages/pypsa/data/component_attrs/stores.csv:39: series, currency/MWh, shadow price of storage consistency equations (water values)
water_value_dual.assignment_flag: assign_all_duals=True is necessary for this local implementation because the default branch tests the static columns, while mu_energy_balance is a series-only attribute.
water_value_dual.assignment_steps: Parse Store-energy_balance -> component Store / suffix energy_balance -> mu_energy_balance, convert xarray snapshot/name to pandas snapshot rows and Store-name columns, then set dynamic data without sign or numerical scaling.
water_value_dual.sign_convention: Preserve the raw native dual sign. Positive mu is positive marginal water value: adding one MWh_water of physical inflow is equivalent to reducing the combined energy-balance RHS by one MWh, so it changes the minimized objective by -mu EUR.
water_value_dual.canonical_unit: EUR/MWh_water when the objective is EUR and the Store energy basis is MWh_water.
water_value_dual.objective_weight_scaling: Do not divide Store mu by snapshot_weightings.objective. Native post_processing at optimize.py:1120-1130 divides only Bus marginal prices; the Store balance already has an MWh RHS.
water_value_dual.electrical_equivalent_optional: For a constant positive turbine efficiency, mu/eta_turbine is a derived EUR/MWh_electric water opportunity value. Retain raw EUR/MWh_water as canonical; do not substitute this derived value for the native Store dual.
water_value_dual.not_equal_to_zonal_price_by_definition: Water value is an intertemporal scarcity value. Turbine/pump bounds, Store state bounds, spill, efficiencies and losses may create wedges; do not assert equality with zonal power prices at every hour.
water_value_dual.nonnegativity: Do not clip, force nonnegativity or replace finite negative values. Report the native finite dual and diagnose physical/economic context if unexpected.

future_fixed_commitment_LP_extractor_con.authority: Only a verified FIXED_COMMITMENT_PRICE_LP result. UC_MILP remains the physical generation, pumping, spill and water-state authority.
preconditions: Solve receipt identifies FIXED_COMMITMENT_PRICE_LP, solver_status=ok and termination_condition=optimal.
Solve receipt contains integer_variables=0 and binary_variables=0.
fixed_commitment_milp_sha256 matches the verified UC_MILP solved network hash.
status/start_up/shut_down trajectories match the verified UC_MILP commitment and objective reconciliation passes existing price verification.
The audited price-solve path assigned all duals; never infer valid dual authority from a finite table alone.
Select expected hydro/PHS water Stores by accepted state mapping and water buses, excluding BESS.
Require the expected ordered snapshots and every selected active Store; reject duplicates, missing entries, NaN and inf.
With the live model available, confirm the selected Store-energy_balance raw dual labels and finite values before reading assigned tables.
For a serialized network, combine table completeness with its verified fixed-LP receipt/hash; the serialized network cannot independently prove how the duals were obtained.
future_fixed_commitment_LP_extractor_con.zero_value_caveat: Native _set_dynamic_data at optimization/common.py:71 fills missing reindexed values with 0.0. A finite zero is not by itself proof of a genuine dual. Check raw active constraint coverage and verified LP provenance; do not fill missing extractor entries.
future_fixed_commitment_LP_extractor_con.MILP_caveat: Linopy Gurobi get_solver_solution at solvers.py:1248 reads constraint.Pi directly; missing MILP Pi yields an empty dual series. Absence or placeholders must not become water-value reporting.

existing_MEM_integration.builder_contract: One water-energy Store, turbine Link with p_nom=NET_MW/eta_turbine, optional electrical-input pump Link, forced water inflow Generator, explicit sign=-1 spill Generator. Default Store/turbine/pump costs are zero; no external water-cost term is introduced by this builder.
existing_MEM_integration.price_solve_contract: linearized_unit_commitment=True for FIXED_COMMITMENT_PRICE_LP, fixed status/start_up/shut_down from UC_MILP, rejects binary/integer LP variables, calls solve_model(assign_all_duals=True), records UC source hash.
existing_MEM_integration.price_verifier_contract: Checks UC source hash, LP variable type, commitment trajectories, objective reconciliation and full-year zonal prices. It currently contains no dedicated hydro Store-dual extraction or completeness gate.

source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.finding: Native define_store_constraints docstring says positive p charges and gives e=previous+p*hours; executable LHS gives e=previous-p*hours. stores.csv says p is positive net supply, consistent with code.
source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.resolution: Use executable equation and component output convention; no package or methodology change is required.

source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.finding: Default assign_duals can omit Store energy_balance despite its dynamic schema placeholder because it tests c.static rather than dynamic/default schema.
source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.resolution: Reuse the existing fixed-price solve path's assign_all_duals=True.

source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.finding: Existing spill p_nom=max(NET turbine MW + electrical pump MW,1) is numerically a MW_water sink cap. Those controls do not establish an accepted hydrological spill power limit, and the expression does not equal turbine water-input plus pump water-output ratings.
source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.resolution: Lead must compare actual forced inflow/state bounds and accepted spill authority; this inspection makes no capacity or model change.

source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.finding: Cyclic annual operation requires wrapped pre-first state, not equality of first and last post-snapshot output rows.
source_discrepancies_and_potential_struc.resolution: Use final output as the predecessor of the first snapshot in cyclic residuals.

validation.method: Installed source and component-attribute inspection; no source changes, downloads, network construction, model construction, or optimization.
validation.numeric_test_reason: Executable source and Gurobi Pi assignment fully determine convention; an isolated solve is unnecessary and outside the assigned read-only source scope.
